# Dublin Rental Repair Request Draft

A polite, firm message can keep the tone professional while clearly stating the issue, timeline, and requested action. I’ve also included a short repair checklist and what to document before you send it.

## Landlord Message and Repair Checklist

### Message draft
**Subject:** Request for urgent kitchen sink repair

Hello [Landlord Name],

I’m writing again about the kitchen sink leak in my 2-bedroom apartment in Dublin. The leak has been happening under the cabinet for 10 days, and there is now visible water damage.

I notified you by text once already, but I have not yet received a response. Please arrange for this to be inspected and repaired as soon as possible, as I’m concerned the leak may cause further damage.

Could you please confirm when someone will attend to fix it?

Thank you,
[Your Name]
[Apartment Address]
[Phone Number]

### Concise repair checklist
- Leak under kitchen sink for 10 days
- Visible water damage under/around cabinet
- Landlord notified once by text
- No response received yet
- Request inspection and repair date
- Ask for confirmation in writing

### Evidence to document before sending
- Take clear photos of the leak, cabinet area, and visible water damage
- Record the date and time of each photo
- Save the original text message you sent to the landlord
- Note when the leak started and whether it has worsened
- Keep any receipts or notes if you had to clean up water or move items

## Polite Follow-Up Version

If you want it a little softer, you can send this version:

Hello [Landlord Name],

I hope you’re well. I’m following up on the kitchen sink leak in my 2-bedroom apartment, which has been leaking under the cabinet for the past 10 days and has caused visible water damage.

I sent a text about this earlier but haven’t heard back yet. Could you please let me know when the repair can be arranged? I’d appreciate your help in resolving it soon.

Thank you,
[Your Name]

## Quick Actions
Action: [Button: Copy message] https://www.dublincity.ie/residential/housing/tenant-information
Action: [Button: Tenant rights] https://threshold.ie/advice/

## Sources
- Threshold Ireland tenant advice: https://threshold.ie/advice/
- Dublin City Council housing information: https://www.dublincity.ie/residential/housing/tenant-information
